data.name: Nimesha
data.long_meaning: Nimesha is a Sanskrit name derived from the root word 'nim' which means to recall, remember or contemplate. It is a divine name associated with the Goddess Saraswati, the goddess of knowledge, learning, and wisdom. The name Nimesha signifies the act of deep contemplation and introspection, encouraging one to recall and remember the spiritual teachings and wisdom passed down through generations.
